title: What If a Giant Mirror in Orbit Lit Up a City at Night?
subject: space mirror

scenes.text: What if a mirror in space turned night into day? Russia actually tried it.
In February 1993, Russia unfolded Znamya 2 in orbit, a mirror 20 meters wide.
It threw a bright spot about 5 kilometers wide across Europe at roughly 8 kilometers per second.
The glow was about as bright as a full moon.
A bigger version, Znamya 2.5, was meant to hit 5 to 10 full moons of light over 7 kilometers.
But in 1999 its 25-meter mirror caught on an antenna and ripped, and it burned up on reentry.

description:
What if a giant mirror in orbit lit up a city at night?
